items.title_en: Union Ministers Review Stubble Management Strategy
items.title_hi: केंद्रीय मंत्रियों ने पराली प्रबंधन रणनीति की समीक्षा की
items.summary: Union Agriculture Minister Shivraj Singh Chouhan and Environment Minister Bhupender Yadav held a joint high-level review meeting focusing on proactive stubble (parali) management. The session aimed to minimize air pollution and coordinate state-level implementation ahead of the peak winter harvesting cycle.
key_bullets: Joint meeting chaired by: Union Agriculture Minister Shivraj Singh Chouhan and Environment Minister Bhupender Yadav.
Primary objective: Proactive stubble burning mitigation and inter-ministerial coordination.
Target timeline: Peak winter agricultural residue management in northern agrarian states.

static_gk.details: Statutory body established under the Commission for Air Quality Management in National Capital Region and Adjoining Areas Act, 2021.

recommended_video.title: Stubble Burning & Air Quality Management Strategies

mcq.question: Who recently chaired the joint high-level review meeting on stubble management in October 2026? / अक्टूबर 2026 में पराली प्रबंधन पर संयुक्त उच्च स्तरीय समीक्षा बैठक की अध्यक्षता किसने की?
options: Shivraj Singh Chouhan and Bhupender Yadav
Narendra Modi and Hardeep Singh Puri
mcq.explanation: Union Agriculture Minister Shivraj Singh Chouhan and Environment Minister Bhupender Yadav jointly reviewed the stubble management strategies to curb winter air pollution. Other options involve ministers with different portfolios.

items.title_en: India Hosts First BIMSTEC Home Ministers' Meeting
items.title_hi: भारत ने BIMSTEC गृह मंत्रियों की पहली बैठक की मेज़बानी की
items.summary: India hosted the inaugural meeting of BIMSTEC Home Ministers in New Delhi under the chairpersonship of Union Home Minister Amit Shah. The multilateral engagement focused on boosting regional security cooperation, counter-terrorism, and disaster management frameworks.
key_bullets: Event: 1st BIMSTEC Home Ministers' Meeting held in New Delhi.
Chaired by: Union Home Minister Amit Shah.
Focus areas: Transnational crime, counter-terrorism, maritime security, and disaster response.

static_gk.fact: BIMSTEC (Bay of Bengal Initiative for Multi-Sectoral Technical and Economic Cooperation)
static_gk.details: Established in 1997 via the Bangkok Declaration. Headquarters: Dhaka, Bangladesh. Member states: 7 (Bangladesh, Bhutan, India, Myanmar, Nepal, Sri Lanka, Thailand).

recommended_video.query: BIMSTEC Home Ministers Meeting Amit Shah
recommended_video.title: International Summits & Bilateral Meets: Current Affairs

mcq.question: Which country hosted the first-ever BIMSTEC Home Ministers' Meeting in New Delhi? / नई दिल्ली में पहली बार BIMSTEC गृह मंत्रियों की बैठक की मेज़बानी किस देश ने की?
mcq.explanation: India hosted the first BIMSTEC Home Ministers' meeting in New Delhi under the chairmanship of Union Home Minister Amit Shah. BIMSTEC comprises 7 nations bordering the Bay of Bengal region.

items.title_en: Ministry of Panchayati Raj to Launch Special Campaign 6.0
items.title_hi: पंचायती राज मंत्रालय विशेष अभियान 6.0 लॉन्च करेगा
items.summary: The Ministry of Panchayati Raj is scheduled to conduct an extensive cleanliness drive and clear pending administrative references on October 14, 2026, under Special Campaign 6.0. The initiative emphasizes institutional housekeeping, file management, and office space optimization.
key_bullets: Campaign: Special Campaign 6.0 for Swachhata and pendency disposal.
Execution Date: 14 October 2026.
Spearheading Ministry: Ministry of Panchayati Raj.

static_gk.details: Operational as an independent ministry since May 2004. Responsible for matters relating to the Panchayati Raj institutions enshrined under Part IX of the Constitution.

mcq.question: Under which special drive is the Ministry of Panchayati Raj conducting cleanliness and pendency clearance on October 14, 2026? / पंचायती राज मंत्रालय किस विशेष अभियान के तहत स्वच्छता और लंबित मामलों का निपटारा कर रहा है?
mcq.explanation: The Ministry of Panchayati Raj is executing the cleanliness drive and pending case disposal under Special Campaign 6.0 on October 14, 2026. This campaign focuses on institutional efficiency and cleanliness.

items.title_en: Agrivision–2026 10th National Convention Held in New Delhi
items.title_hi: नई दिल्ली में एग्रीविजन–2026 के 10वें राष्ट्रीय अधिवेशन का आयोजन
items.summary: The 10th National Convention of Agrivision–2026 was successfully hosted in New Delhi, bringing together agricultural experts, policymakers, and young farmers. The convention deliberated on sustainable farming technologies, rural entrepreneurship, and futuristic agricultural roadmaps.
key_bullets: Edition: 10th National Convention of Agrivision–2026.
Location: New Delhi.
Core theme: Modern farming technologies, agri-startups, and sustainable agrarian growth.

static_gk.details: First comprehensive National Agriculture Policy was announced in July 2000 with an objective to attain a growth rate in excess of 4% per annum in the agriculture sector.

mcq.question: Agrivision–2026 held its landmark 10th National Convention in which city? / एग्रीविजन-2026 का 10वां राष्ट्रीय अधिवेशन किस शहर में आयोजित किया गया?
mcq.explanation: Agrivision–2026 hosted its 10th National Convention in New Delhi, focusing on modernizing Indian agriculture and encouraging youth participation in farming sectors.

items.title_hi: 'इंडिया स्किल्स 2026-27' के लिए पंजीकरण विंडो फिर से खुली
items.summary: Following unprecedented demand from young aspirants across the country, the registration window for 'India Skills 2026–27' has been officially extended and reopened until October 19, 2026. The mega-event aims to identify and nurture top vocational talent for global competition platforms.
key_bullets: Initiative: India Skills 2026–27 skill competition.
Extended registration deadline: 19 October 2026.
Reason for extension: Overwhelming candidate demand across states.

static_gk.details: Public-Private Partnership (PPP) model under the Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship (MSDE), established in 2008.

mcq.question: What is the revised final date for registration under 'India Skills 2026–27'? / 'इंडिया स्किल्स 2026-27' के तहत पंजीकरण की संशोधित अंतिम तिथि क्या है?
mcq.explanation: Due to massive candidate demand, the registration window for India Skills 2026–27 was reopened with the deadline extended to October 19, 2026.

items.title_en: Stock Market Surge: Investors Earn Rs 4 Trillion as Sensex Jumps 1,100 Points
items.title_hi: शेयर बाजार में तेजी: सेंसेक्स 1,100 अंक उछला, निवेशकों ने 4 लाख करोड़ कमाए
items.summary: Indian benchmark indices witnessed a massive rally, with the BSE Sensex surging over 1,100 points in a single session. Investor wealth increased by approximately Rs 4 trillion, propelled by robust buying in heavyweight counters and positive macroeconomic cues.
key_bullets: Market index movement: BSE Sensex rallied by over 1,100 points.
Investor wealth accretion: Approximately Rs 4 trillion gained in a single day.
Driving factors: FII buying interest, strong sectoral indices, and upbeat quarterly earnings outlook.

static_gk.details: Asia's oldest stock exchange, established in 1875. Located at Dalal Street, Mumbai. Index: S&P BSE Sensex (30 stocks).

mcq.question: By approximately how much did investor wealth increase during the recent Sensex rally of over 1,100 points? / हाल ही में 1,100 से अधिक अंकों की सेंसेक्स तेजी के दौरान निवेशकों की संपत्ति में लगभग कितने लाख करोड़ रुपये की वृद्धि हुई?
mcq.explanation: Investors gained approximately Rs 4 trillion as the BSE Sensex closed over 1,100 points higher, driven by broad-based market buying.

items.title_en: NPCI Clarifies UPI MDR Implementation Timeline Post-Diwali
items.title_hi: NPCI ने स्पष्ट किया: दिवाली के बाद लागू होगा UPI भुगतानों पर MDR चार्ज
items.summary: The National Payments Corporation of India (NPCI) has announced that Merchant Discount Rate (MDR) charges on specific UPI transactions will be implemented following the Diwali festival period. The move aims to balance merchant sustainability with the sustained growth of digital payments.
key_bullets: Body involved: National Payments Corporation of India (NPCI).
Subject: MDR (Merchant Discount Rate) charges on UPI payments.
Implementation timeline: Scheduled to take effect post-Diwali.

static_gk.details: Founded in 2008. An initiative of RBI and IBA under the Payment and Settlement Systems Act, 2007. Headquarters: Mumbai, Maharashtra.

recommended_video.query: UPI MDR Charges NPCI Economy News
recommended_video.title: Digital Payments & Economy Current Affairs

mcq.question: According to NPCI, when will MDR charges on certain UPI transactions be implemented? / NPCI के अनुसार, कुछ UPI लेन-देन पर MDR शुल्क कब लागू किया जाएगा?
mcq.explanation: NPCI clarified that MDR charges on UPI payments will be implemented post-Diwali to ensure a smooth transition and maintain digital transaction momentum during the festive season.

items.title_en: India Rupee Outpaces Asian Peers on Fresh FX Curbs and RBI Intervention
items.title_hi: नए विदेशी मुद्रा नियंत्रण और RBI के हस्तक्षेप से भारतीय रुपया एशियाई समकक्षों से आगे निकला
items.summary: The Indian rupee outperformed major Asian currency peers, supported by targeted foreign exchange curbs and proactive intervention by the Reserve Bank of India (RBI). These strategic monetary steps helped stabilize domestic currency volatility amid global market headwinds.
key_bullets: Currency performance: Rupee outpaced regional Asian peer currencies.
Supportive mechanisms: Fresh FX curbs and proactive RBI liquidity/forex interventions.
Impact: Enhanced stability against global macroeconomic uncertainties.

static_gk.details: Established on April 1, 1935, under the Reserve Bank of India Act, 1934. Nationalized in 1949. Headquarters: Mumbai. Current Governor: Shaktikanta Das (or incumbent).

mcq.question: Which institution's active intervention and FX curbs helped the Indian rupee outperform Asian peers? / किस संस्था के सक्रिय हस्तक्षेप और विदेशी मुद्रा नियंत्रण उपायों ने भारतीय रुपये को एशियाई समकक्षों से आगे रहने में मदद की?
mcq.explanation: The Reserve Bank of India (RBI) utilized targeted forex market interventions and regulatory measures to stabilize the rupee and help it outperform regional Asian currencies.

items.title_en: Election Commission Launches Nationwide Campaign Against Voter Omission
items.title_hi: चुनाव आयोग ने मतदाता छूट रोकने के लिए देशव्यापी अभियान शुरू किया
items.summary: The Election Commission of India has rolled out a comprehensive nationwide campaign to ensure that no eligible voter is left out of electoral rolls. The special drive focuses on door-to-door verification, youth registration, and bridging demographic gaps in voter lists.
key_bullets: Executing body: Election Commission of India (ECI).
Objective: To ensure zero eligible voter exclusion from electoral rolls.
Key focus: Booth-level verification, awareness drives, and first-time voter enrolment.

static_gk.details: Established on 25 January 1950 (celebrated as National Voters' Day). Constitutional Body under Article 324.

mcq.question: Under which constitutional article is the Election Commission of India established? / भारत का निर्वाचन आयोग किस संवैधानिक अनुच्छेद के अंतर्गत स्थापित किया गया है?
mcq.explanation: The Election Commission of India is an autonomous constitutional authority established under Article 324 of the Constitution to administer election processes in India.

items.title_en: Tata Sons' N Chandrasekaran Emphasizes Long-Term Semiconductor Future
items.title_hi: टाटा सन्स के एन चंद्रशेखरन ने दीर्घकालिक सेमीकंडक्टर भविष्य पर जोर दिया
items.summary: Tata Sons Chairman N Chandrasekaran stated that semiconductor manufacturing will matter profoundly in the long run for India's technological sovereignty, even if financial returns take time to materialize. He highlighted ongoing investments in chip fabrication and domestic supply chain resilience.
key_bullets: Key speaker: N Chandrasekaran, Chairman of Tata Sons.
Core domain: Semiconductor manufacturing and long-term tech strategy.
Key takeaway: Strategic importance of indigenous chip-making capabilities for economic security.

static_gk.details: Launched under the Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology (MeitY) with a financial outlay to build a vibrant semiconductor and display ecosystem in India.

mcq.question: Which Indian industrialist recently emphasized that semiconductor manufacturing is critical for India's long-term technological future? / किस भारतीय उद्योगपति ने हाल ही में इस बात पर जोर दिया कि सेमीकंडक्टर निर्माण भारत के दीर्घकालिक तकनीकी भविष्य के लिए महत्वपूर्ण है?
mcq.explanation: Tata Sons Chairman N Chandrasekaran highlighted that chips will matter significantly in the long run for India, underlining Tata's commitment to the semiconductor fabrication sector.
